slides.title: A seafood night 2 minutes from Akihabara Station
slides.dek: Domannaka Akihabara Bettei, a basement izakaya. Here's what Yu ordered.

slides.title: Sea urchin hand roll
slides.body: Topped with caviar. Eat it right away, before the seaweed softens.

slides.title: Namero with salmon roe
slides.body: Raw fish chopped with miso and herbs, a fishermen's dish.

slides.title: Rare aji fry, bones and all

slides.title: The potato-salad tower
slides.body: Potato salad piled high under shaved bonito flakes.

slides.title: Save this for a night in Akihabara
